# aidial Provider

Terraform provider for [EPAM AI DIAL Core](https://github.com/epam/ai-dial-core): manage roles, keys, models and routes as code. Authenticate with either `api_key` or `id_token` (an OIDC JWT from a CI/CD system); a value in the provider block beats its environment variable (`AIDIAL_API_KEY`, `AIDIAL_ID_TOKEN`), and an ignored variable produces a warning. See the README for details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aidial = {
      source  = "epam/aidial"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

provider "aidial" {
  base_url = "https://dial-core.example.com"
  api_key  = var.aidial_api_key
}

variable "aidial_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# In CI/CD, authenticate with an OIDC ID token instead of an API key.
# Use one credential per provider block; both may also come from the
# AIDIAL_API_KEY / AIDIAL_ID_TOKEN environment variables.
provider "aidial" {
  alias    = "ci"
  base_url = "https://dial-core.example.com"
  id_token = var.aidial_id_token
}

variable "aidial_id_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) DIAL API base URL, for example http://IP:PORT or https://IP:PORT.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) DIAL API key sent in the `Api-Key` header. Falls back to the `AIDIAL_API_KEY` environment variable. Exactly one credential is used: see the provider description for precedence.
- `id_token` (String, Sensitive) OIDC ID token (JWT) from a CI/CD system, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Falls back to the `AIDIAL_ID_TOKEN` environment variable. The provider never fetches or refreshes it, so it must outlive the whole run. Alternative to `api_key`.
